dialogues.speaker: Linyang
dialogues.text: Oh, on Dragonspine, you say... Give me a moment...

dialogues.speaker: Linyang
dialogues.text: I remember that someone named Iris was in charge of placing items in the Dragonspine area... She really is very impressive...

dialogues.speaker: Linyang
dialogues.text: There, I've marked some of the locations out for you. Take a look at your map.
